integrity: Proof by complementary free sum, cycle incidence singular determinant, explicit color-block facet normals, paired triangle inequality and uniform Riemann sums. Exact Gram checks are supplemental; no independent external validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The result is for the inherited Euclidean metric and common scaling within each color class, not arbitrary edge weights; the exact unscaled support-plane norm was established earlier and is not claimed as new. The beta limit is weak convergence and is uniform over positive aspect ratios. Historical priority remains provisional.
title: Sharp anisotropic boundary inequality and universal beta facet law for even-cycle edge polytopes
